comment: Parameters 26 and 27, Ghost Notes and Accent, are configured but have no ParamWidget and are never read in process(), so they get no line, no tag and no props. The eight voices are named Timeline 1 and 2, Foundation 1 and 2, Groove 1 and 2, and Lead 1 and 2, and the panel places the four role blocks in the order Lead, Groove, Timeline, Foundation from the top. Panning is a fixed table per voice, 0.20 and 0.25 for Timeline, 0 for both Foundation voices, -0.30 and +0.30 for Groove and -0.40 and -0.50 for Lead, all scaled by SPREAD (src/UniversalRhythm.cpp:2052-2053). The external audio inputs are not passed straight through: each is multiplied by its voice's own envelope and velocity and boosted by half again on an accented step (src/UniversalRhythm.cpp:2069-2078). The style CV adds one whole style per volt before rounding, and the density CV a tenth of the knob's travel per volt; neither has an attenuator. Several CV jacks add a fixed amount of parameter per volt rather than one of the four range shapes, so range is left off those. The panel prints CLOCK, RESET, REGEN, VARI, HUMAN, SWING, REST, FILL, ARTICULATION, SPREAD, then STYLE, DENSITY, LENGTH, FREQ, DECAY, EXT IN 1, MIX and EXT IN 2 in each role block, and Audio, Gate, Freq, Velo and MIX over the output rows. Lettering is drawn in code at src/UniversalRhythm.cpp:2531-2752.
